drop_hint: Converted in your browser. Nothing is uploaded. Accepts HEIC, HEIF, WebP, AVIF, PNG, JPEG.
drop_note: HEIC/HEIF: only the first image in a file is converted. EXIF and orientation are dropped. If your browser cannot open HEIC natively, the decoder loads on first use and may take a few seconds.
q_hint: Applies to JPEG and WebP (and AVIF where available).
action_hint: Add images to enable Convert. ZIP download is available for 2 or more converted files.
noscript: This converter needs JavaScript; it runs only on your device.
limits_html: Limitations: for HEIC/HEIF files with several images (bursts, live photos, sequences) only the first/primary image is converted. EXIF metadata (camera data, GPS location, date) is not kept, and EXIF orientation is not applied, so some photos may come out rotated.
safari_html: Browser testing: tested in Chrome/Chromium, Firefox and a WebKit engine build. Safari on macOS and iOS/iPadOS is not fully tested yet; if something does not work there, please report it on GitHub.
notes_summary_html: Limitations and browser support · only the first image in a HEIC/HEIF file is converted; EXIF and orientation are dropped; Safari/iOS not fully tested yet
foot_html: Free, open-source, runs entirely in your browser. No uploads, no cookies, no ads. Not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by any device maker, browser or software vendor; format names are used descriptively only. Source: GitHub.

index_h1: Convert images locally in your browser
index_lead_html: HEIC/HEIF, WebP, AVIF, PNG, JPEG → JPEG, PNG, WebP (AVIF if your browser can encode it). Your files are processed on your device and never uploaded.
pair_title: {A} to {B} converter – free, in your browser, no upload | Local Image Converter
pair_desc: Convert {A} images to {B} in your browser. Batch conversion, quality slider, zip download. Files stay on your device; no upload, no ads, no cookies.
pair_lead: Choose or drop {A} files, the output is preset to {B}. Conversion runs on your device; the files are not uploaded. You can convert several files at once and download them one by one or as a zip.

notes.heic: HEIC/HEIF is opened natively if your browser supports it; otherwise a WebAssembly decoder (libheif) is loaded from this site and runs locally.
notes.webp: WebP is decoded by your browser's built-in decoder.
notes.avif: AVIF is decoded by your browser's built-in decoder (supported in current Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari versions).
notes.png: PNG is decoded by your browser.
notes.jpg: JPEG is decoded by your browser.

outn.jpg: JPG has no transparency, so transparent areas become white.
outn.png: PNG is lossless, so files can be larger than the original; the quality slider has no effect.
outn.webp: WebP output keeps transparency and is usually smaller than PNG or JPG; WebP encoding needs a browser that supports it (Chrome, Edge, Firefox; Safari may not encode WebP).

other_formats: Other formats are accepted too; you can change the output format below.
